title: Ho index
formula:
The Ho Index is calculated by the addition of the selected points:

| Variable | Points | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mean stool frequency, stools/24 hrs | ≤4 | 0 |
| >4 to ≤6 | 1 | |
| >6 to ≤9 | 2 | |
| >9 | 4 | |
| Colonic dilatation | Absent | 0 |
| Present | 4 | |
| Hypoalbuminemia, albumin ≤3 g/dL (30 g/L) | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |

how_to_use.when:
- Use in patients presenting with symptoms consistent with acute severe ulcerative colitis who are admitted to the hospital.
- This tool should be used on day 3 of admission to predict failure of medical therapy and thus, need for escalation of therapy.
- Based on retrospective case study review, this score contains more clinical inputs than the Travis Criteria.
- Initial studies showed an 85% sensitivity when a cutoff of ≥4 was used.

next_steps.management:
À mesure que les scores index augmentent, le risque prédit d’échec du traitement médical (corticoïdes IV) augmente également.

Chez les patients à haut risque (score index ≥4), envisager d’autres traitements tels que les immunomodulateurs et la chirurgie. Veiller à ce que votre patient bénéficie d’un suivi approprié et d’un traitement d’entretien à la sortie.

more_info:
Interprétation :

| Ho Index | Niveau de risque | Risque d’échec du traitement médical |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0-1 | Faible | 11% |
| 2-3 | Intermédiaire | 45% |
| 4-9 | Élevé | 85% |
